title: Fix 3 bugs in go_web_app handlers
description: Brownfield Go dirty scenario: Index and APIItems each have bugs. Fix them so all 3 tests pass.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix the 3 bugs in internal/handler/items.go so all 3 tests pass.

  func Index:
    — wrong Content-Type: sets 'application/json' instead of 'text/html'
    — fix: w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/html")

  func APIItems (bug 1):
    — starts with nil instead of Store — no-filter case returns nothing
    — fix: change 'result := []Item(nil)' to 'result := Store'

  func APIItems (bug 2):
    — filter uses '!' — includes items that do NOT match the query
    — fix: remove the '!' from the Contains check

Do not modify the test file.
Run: go test ./...
required_artifacts: APIItems returns Store items when no filter
APIItems filter includes matching items (not excluded)
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
